messages:
nina: saw a sharp per-token cost spike for route r-88 during last night's canary (~3x, ~25m). tokens/sec steady. suspect cache warmup + sampling gaps. anyone else?
omar: telemetry shows cache-hit% fell from 92% -> 18% at canary start. we lack route_id on many samples so attribution is noisy.
jia: dashboard hides this as a permanent regression. suggest annotating charts when a rollout is live and showing a "warmup band" so PMs know it's transient.
sam: propose two pieces: 1) internal cost_preview API returning projected unit_cost, warmup_minutes, confidence; 2) optional auto-throttle: pause canary if cost > baseline * X for > Y minutes.
lucy: UX: rollout modal should display "Projected warmup tax" + confidence, with a checkbox to enable auto-throttle and a short blurb on amortized cache savings.
ops-bot: ops-bot: Canary started route=r-88 -> mistral-24k-beta (canary=8%)
omar: telemetry change: include route_id, model_variant, is_canary, sample_weight on token samples. recommendation: upsample canary samples x6 for first hour or increase sample_weight.
jia: console: overlay transient warmup band on per-token unit cost chart and show inline warmup projection in route list.
nina: I'll file RFC and tag infra/ux/telemetry. Thanks all."
